Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination for all three elements: Ce and In are each surrounded by four Pt neighbors, while Pt is coordinated by two Ce and two In, with neighbor distances ranging from 2.8372 to 2.9575 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Ce and In tetrahedra, and corner-sharing between Ce tetrahedra, with In tetrahedra additionally showing corner and edge sharing.
